lag.evidence_source: [/page/9/Text/1] Scale reliabilities of the intrinsic and financials goal of AI at both waves are good for both groups, with alpha ranging from .74 to .91. As in Study 1, RFGI is computed by subtracting the means of AI from the means of the three financial goal items, and is used as an indicator of materialism. Also similar to Study 1, life satisfaction is measured by the five items of Diener et al.'s SLS (1985). Scale reliabilities for the two waves are good among the two groups, and alpha ranges from .74 to .81.
